newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen in doldrums on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen in doldrums on profit-taking.

text.p: Danish share prices dipped in early trade on Wednesday with dealers foreseeing that the market would remain in the doldrums all day due to profit-taking.
"Profit-taking is very much the order of the day so I don't see the Danish share market rising despite the late Dow overnight recovery," one dealer warned.
He said the weaker dollar and higher U.S, bond prices had left the Danish market flat in the extreme.
The KFX top-20 index had lost 0.69 point to 170.25 at 0738 GMT, having closed 0.53 point down on Tuesday. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969652
